# Roadmap

<!-- Generated by tools/check_equicord_plugins.py from data/equicord/roadmap.json. Do not edit. -->

The Equicord plugins Qord should port next, most useful and popular first. A plugin drops off this list once it is Tested. To change the order or add one, edit `data/equicord/roadmap.json` and run `python3 tools/check_equicord_plugins.py --write-docs`.

**Good first plugins** need nothing new in the client: the plugin API already has the hooks and services they use. The others need a client change first (a new hook, service or display option), described under *Needs*. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to start.

| # | Plugin | Effort | Good first | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | GameActivityToggle | medium |  | Buttons in the user panel; Discord's synced "share your activity" setting and Spotify's per-account sharing. |
| 2 | BetterSessions | medium |  | A Devices page in settings listing your sessions (GET /auth/sessions), with names and log out. |
| 3 | ReviewDB | large |  | Reviews on profiles from the ReviewDB service: its OAuth login, a profile section, and writing reviews. |
| 4 | RelationshipNotifier | medium |  | Relationship and server-removal events reaching plugins, and plugin notifications. |
| 5 | BlockKeywords | small | yes | Nothing new: the messageFilter hook hides messages matching your keywords or regexes. |
| 6 | FollowVoiceUser | small | yes | Nothing new: "Follow" in the user menu (userContextMenu), then join where they go (voiceStates hook, UiService::joinVoiceChannel). |
| 7 | CopyEmojiMarkdown | small | yes | Nothing new for the emoji picker's menu (emojiSuggestions hook); messages' emojis have no menu yet. |
| 8 | ServerListIndicators | small |  | Friends' online status for plugins; the server list button (serverListButtons hook) already exists. |
| 9 | PreviewMessage | small |  | The message box's text in ChatContext, so a chat bar button can preview it. |
| 10 | DecodeBase64 | small | yes | Nothing new: "Decode Base64" in the message menu (messageContextMenu) showing the decoded text (UiService::showTextDialog). |
| 11 | UnitConverter | small | yes | Nothing new: "Convert Units" in the message menu (messageContextMenu), shown under the message (messageAccessories). |
| 12 | KeywordNotify | medium |  | Notifications for messages matching keywords (notifications hook), and a mentions-inbox tab for them. |
| 13 | MessageLinkTooltip | medium |  | Hover tooltips on message links showing the linked message (the fetch_messages service exists). |
| 14 | ReplyTimestamp | small |  | A hook for the reply line above a message, to show when the replied message was sent. |
| 15 | CharacterCounter | small |  | A way for plugins to show text next to the message box as you type. |
| 16 | ShowTimeoutDuration | small |  | Discord's timeout icon next to timed-out members, which plugins can then label with the time left. |
| 17 | VoiceChannelLog | medium |  | A log view of who joined and left a voice channel (the voiceStates hook exists). |
| 18 | Timezones | medium |  | Per-user time zones, shown next to message timestamps and in profiles. |
| 19 | PictureInPicture | medium |  | Pop-out playback for video attachments. |
| 20 | NoPendingCount | small |  | A display option to hide the pending request count on the Friends page and home icon. |
| 21 | VoiceChatDoubleClick | small |  | A display option so voice channels join on double click instead of single click. |
| 22 | ClickableRoles | small |  | Clicks on profile roles reaching plugins (the profileRoleButtons hook is close). |
| 23 | MoreQuickReactions | medium |  | Plugin control over how many reactions the hover bar offers. |
| 24 | MentionAvatars | medium |  | Avatars inside user mentions when rendering messages. |
| 25 | LastActive | medium |  | A user menu item that searches for their last message (search API). |
| 26 | StreamerModeOn | medium |  | A streamer mode in the client (hides personal information) that plugins can switch. |
| 27 | CustomIdle | small |  | Plugin control over when the client sets you idle. |
| 28 | UnreadCountBadge | small |  | Unread counts on channels in the channel list (a display option). |
| 29 | NoTypingAnimation | small |  | A display option to stop the typing indicator's dots animating. |
| 30 | SilenceUsers | medium |  | Per-user silencing of notifications and sounds (the notifications hook exists). |

Beyond this list, 317 plugins are Not Started; [the compatibility matrix](equicord-plugin-compatibility.md) has all of them.
